sentence: This project studies how mammal tails evolved, how they develop, and how bone, tendon and muscle connections shape tail use.
This project builds a predictive framework that tracks fatigue damage in metals made by additive manufacturing.
This project builds a programming framework that combines deep learning with logical reasoning, and tries it on breast cancer risk assessment from mammograms.
This project builds case studies about artificial intelligence technologies to show the social and ethical risks in security and privacy.
This project studies the geometry of how neural networks are trained, to explain when they generalize well on new data.
This project builds tools that find security weaknesses in open-source artificial intelligence software and help researchers fix them.
This project builds a toolkit that designs dyes, organic molecules that absorb and emit light, for quantum computing.
This project builds intrusion detection systems that let edge devices share knowledge about threats and remember past attacks without exposing raw data.
This project builds a laboratory for artificial intelligence and robotics and a degree in information technology and artificial intelligence.
This project builds tools that use camera trap images to study how animals with seasonal camouflage cope when coat color does not match snow.
This project designs a filter that changes itself after a false positive match, so it keeps working well for a stream of queries.
This project builds software that sorts online videos of hand-object interactions into searchable data so robots can learn to manipulate objects.
This project studies how laser-based additive manufacturing can make folding metal origami from a shape memory alloy.
This project builds an all-digital trigger that uses deep learning to help radio antennas buried in cold ice detect neutrino interactions.
This project builds artificial intelligence methods that use principles from physics to help discover physics and to understand artificial intelligence better.
This project tests whether chemical gradients in soil can speed up the movement of bacteria toward chemical spills to help clean them up.
This project builds a way to image therapeutic cells inside the body over time, so researchers can see how the cells behave.
